title: Perfectly Replicating Coca Cola (It Took Me A Year)
summary: LabCoatz uses mass spectrometry, with help from other science YouTubers, to reverse engineer the Coca-Cola flavor and builds a chemically-identical replica. The video walks through a year of work on the formula.
why: HN mostly cites it as a notable example of reverse engineering a famously secret formula, not as a recommendation.

quote.text: This content creator used a mass spectrometer to find the flavoring used in Coca-Cola.
